#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF now.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is right there.
Let's #C000246204press on#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's go back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and rest.

Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Obtained
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained

Got it.
Stay back, #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Mongrel.
Know your place!
Is that, #C236196003Rin#CDEF…… and #C236196003Archer#CDEF!?

I get that they're surprised, but so am I!
Why are there two #C236196003Archers#CDEF…!?

Maybe―――he divided!?
Was #C236196003Archer#CDEF a planarian flatworm all along!?

But please keep your cool.
This #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF doesn't seem to be the
same as the one you know.
But that Servant… don't tell me―――?

Got it.
Stay back, #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Bring it on.
Get ready, Master!
I can't disappear… Not now…

Abate your fears, other #C236196003Rin#CDEF.
I realized this during our battle:
this is likely a trick of the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

Your future hasn't been destroyed.
Go on, please slowly open your eyes―――.

My blood hasn't boiled so in a long spell.
Woman, you wield that Faker well.
I commend you on your skills.

Hmm, the perfect balance of tsun and dere. Her
soul is different, but she's like #C236196003Rin#CDEF. Don't
mess with the might of a #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF's word.
Yep… but I bet you don't regret it.

Maybe.
A magus will tell you that what you have now
will one day be gone.

Isn't that… #C236196003Rin#CDEF's #C236196003Lancer#CDEF!?
Is his Master the Commissary clerk?
Now that's an odd duo.

Isn't that #C236196003Rin#CDEF's #C236196003Lancer#CDEF!?
And that shady clerk!
Have these two ever actually met before?

Please step back, Darling!
These two mustn't be taken lightly.
He isn't just some grim-looking geezer!

He's not trained, clerk.
Thrusting himself into our conversation―
like some mad dog.

……………sorry.
I didn't realize there was a joke there.
Oh……… You're still dreadful.

It's not hard to imagine all the complaints
I'll hear from #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF if I side with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF on this.

Shit, they got us…
Well, at least it was one hell of a fight.
―――Heh. You don't like me very much.
Rrr……!

FUUUUCK THIS! Some kinda tick forcin' you
to only ever use #C000246204Command Seal#CDEF to harass me,
asshole!?

Is this…
someone you've met before, Master?

……acquaintances?
That Master and I?

…………I don't know.
It may be possible, for all I know.

…I shall, of course.
Despite this one-tailed form,
I―#C236196003Caster#CDEF―shall fulfill your wish.

…huh?
W-w-w-what is this!?
Kyaa!?

Woah, what demon came up with THIS scenario!?
My ex-Darling meeting my current
Darling―this can't get any worse!

Ahh, I get it.
So that's ultimately what happens.

That's why you failed! What's bad is bad!
It infuriates me to see you not
recognize your mistakes!

Now I'm pissed! I'm MAD!
Taste my Fraudulent-Marriage-Execution-Cannon!
How the hell did this happen?

Mhm. I can't quite grasp this situation, either.
It must not be time yet.
……the mood shifts suddenly.
The calm fades and a biting tension permeates.

#C236196003Caster#CDEF, let's begin.
Enough fooling about.

…yes. Please guide me, Master.
No matter whom I face, I shall utterly
destroy them.

…Darling.
That's me from the past.

…
I know all the aces up your sleeve!
Here I go, Darling!

I knew we had supreme compatibility.
It follows now that we'll have to be wed.
I'm ready whenever!

Yep.
The reason I got this far is because she's been by my side.

Thanks, Master.
I'm a pretty unlucky guy, but I tend
to hit the jackpot with Masters.

Yep.
The reason I got this far is because he's been by my side.
…he still hasn't?

Still, the smile #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF is making towards
me is more gentle than usual.

Yep.
The reason I got this far is because he's been by my side.
My strength comes entirely from being with him.

…I can't believe this.
How are you so STRONG!?

Master… I apologize.
Once again… I…

―――Indeed.
Although, my Servant then might
not be #C236196003Caster#CDEF anymore.

Living the way you do, you're sure to
fall out of love with your husband. FOR SURE!

Even if you're me―gimme a break!
Dammit! I'm NOT JEALOUS!

What an indecent twister of abuse.
Yep, that's me. Twisted.
It honestly bothers even me.
Yeah. I feel exactly the same.

…yep, feels like silk. As per usual.
It gradually soothes away my irritation.

Anyway, it looks like the verdict reads
that we're an invincible couple beyond compare.

I was thinking we could celebrate our victory
all lovey-dovey.
Okay鷙

Yep.
The reason I got this far is because she's been by my side.

You cannot carry any more
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

Wha…… don't tell me
there's an 8th Master!?

Isn't that #C236196003Rin#CDEF!?
But she seems―different somehow……

Huh, #C236196003Rin#CDEF?
But how do I put it……
Their soul is different?

Well, if it isn't the woman in red.
…wait.
―――Ahh, so that's how it is.

That's not the woman you know.
You'll need to strike with full force and
vengeance to bring her to her knees.

…I'm not really sure what's going on,
but an enemy is an enemy.
#C236196003Archer#CDEF, take them on!

No time to hesitate!
Here he comes, Master!

Darling, please stay any hesitation you
may have. I'll be striking back!

Huh? Wait, what the―what's going on!?
Why is there another you there, #C236196003Archer#CDEF!?

Don't freak out, #C236196003Rin#CDEF.
It looks like we've got an irregular in
our #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.

Oh, cool! I'm a unicellular organism!
―――Ahem, don't mind me.
Just having myself a little self-discovery.

I have quite a few questions to ask,
but it doesn't look like we have time to chat.
#C236196003Archer#CDEF, take them on!

The stage you belong on lies elsewhere.
Go now, hurry and awaken from your dream.

…no, your #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF isn't over. This may
be the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF reproducing one potential
"what-if" scenario. A dream, so to speak.

I can't even imagine what the circumstances are,
but you have your own battle, your own story,
right? Hurry back to your proper world.

Don't fret. This is probably an illusionary
setting produced by the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF, an ephemeral
event that will be gone once you awake.

Though I'm sure this is but
a transient battle for you. The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF
likes to put on its own share of shows.

…alright.
Not really sure what this all is, but that means
I get to keep fighting in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.

Then I can't spend all day kneeling here
in defeat. "#C000246204A Tohsaka should always be elegant#CDEF,"
after all.

I'll pay you back someday for this
"valuable experience" you've given me.
Let's go, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.

Understood, Master.
Your ability to flip-flop at will
is what makes you so great.

I see. This other #C236196003Rin#CDEF is noble-minded as well.
I've taken a great liking to her!

…hmph. Still calculating, yet kind. She would
make for a formidable man too, if she were one.
If we were paired―that would be interesting.

…you've got some nerve.
Seems like there's just as much sarcasm
around even when you're split in two, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.

"Split in two" isn't the right way to put it.
I could be wrong, but… it's possible for
Guardians to have collisions like this.

Looks like you've got your hands full
with your own Master, huh?
We've both got it rough.

Lingering attachments aren't easy to escape…
Alright, let's head back, Master.
He managed to wear me down a bit.

#C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF's servant―and the Commissary clerk?
…I don't like this duo at all.

Oh ho. I dunno know what brought us here,
but if we're squaring off,
then I'm all open arms.

I don't care if this is some dream or illusion.
I ain't pullin' any punches.
Gimme your best shot, #[lad][little lady]#.

Hrm? My curls are tingling!
Stay on your guard, Master. Unlike last time,
his spear now heralds certain death!

Get ready, Master!
Don't underestimate #C236196003Lancer#CDEF, and don't
underestimate how strong that clerk is!

Very nice. Now this is some tension.
Alright. I still don't trust you much,
but guide me true, Master.

Heh. I still get no trust? How sad.
Aren't Masters and Servants the epitome
of mutual trust?

Huh? Was that a joke, coming from you?
I bet your policy is
"be trusted to not be trusted" or something.

Hahaha. Now how did you know that?
Did I perhaps command you to
off yourself or something at some point?

Hell if I know!
Why're you commandin' people to off themselves!?
You're rotten to the core, you snake!

I won't deny it, but I'm trying to
reform myself. I won't do anything callous.
You needn't worry and just fight, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.
Don't go back on your word!

Who would've thought I would face YOU?
The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF has rather fine taste.
Don't you agree, clerk?

Heh. And here I thought I would spend my time
as an NPC quietly. Now I'm being hunted in a
place like this. How problematic.

My, how you talk. Yet take a look at that mug
of yours. See how you twist a grin at
fortune and misfortune alike?

You just can't settle down and fulfill your
role. You even went so far as to summon this
dog. Can't sleep at night without conflict?

Hold it.
You ain't gettin' away with callin' me a dog.

Thrusting right in.
………what's the matter?
None of you are laughing.

He THRUSTED in!
What don't you buffoons understand!?
It's an "AUO joke" of #C236196003Lancer#CDEF and his spear!
Yeah… I'm shiverin' from how cold he is.

Hey, you this guy's Master? Listen,
I do feel for you. Workin' with that guy
has to be a pain in the ass.

I do my utmost to hold back from making
any expressions of agreement.

…very well. Looks like there's no need to
give you any sympathy. Get a sense of humor,
you donkeys.

How about I lop off those uncultured
heads of yours with my treasured sword,
then maybe you will!

Hah. Not if my spear skewers that fumin'
head of YOURS. C'mon, Master!
Let's get this party started!

My goodness. I'm not at all up for this.
But I must properly fulfill the duty I'm given,
even if this IS a trick of the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

Well then, #C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF.
Won't you grant this pitiful NPC a
fair chance at a battle?

Very well, I permit it.
Entertain me until you drop dead!

Mhm. I was able to have my fill of martial
dance, too. If we were in the colosseum, there
would've been a thunderous applause.

Yeah, a shame this wasn't the final selection.
I'd like a fight with you on the big stage.

You're welcome. I wasn't sure myself how
a battle between a dog and a fox would turn
out, but I rather enjoyed it.

As I said I would, I drew out your full power.
Are you satisfied now, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF?

Yeah, you brought the heat―surprisingly.
Still, the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's whimsy aside, I'll pass
on pairin' up with you a second time.

See ya. Illusion or no, I had a blast.
Keep kickin' ass out there, #[lad][little lady]#.

Hmph. Mangy, mad dog.
You may bow down and repent
for troubling me now.

Shit, this is just sad…
I got the short end of the stick
in this matchup.

Will you step up to face me yourself
next, clerk? I don't mind at all.

―――Heh. Point a blade towards the
#C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF? That dog there showed us
enough of such folly.

Hey, wait, wait, wait!
This may be an illusion, but you're supposed
to ACT like my Master!

Oh, sorry. I accidentally slipped out how
I really feel. You fought valiantly, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.
As your Master, I want to reward you.

By this #C000246204Command Seal#CDEF, I order you:
finish 10 plates of Koshuensaikan Taizan
mapo tofu. Every last bite.

Now, then. #C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF, and you, Master.
I wish you good luck in your endeavors.

…that's a terrifying punishment.
It gives even me chills.
Hey, wait.

Wasn't that one of his favorite dishes…?
Maybe he actually WAS trying to reward #C236196003Lancer#CDEF?

Oh? Did you start over, too? I've lost count of
which retry I'm on. I'm taking advantage of the
distortion in this space, too…

…forget it, my guess was off.
You seem different.
Like an innocent, lost child.

Well, I have to eliminate you now.
I can't be having any rumors going around of
"a ghost that keeps retrying."

Sorry, but I need you gone. Oh, please. You're
what they call "a typical powerhouse." Goodness
me. It's baffling how worthless you are.

Who's that?
I don't know him―――
Do you recall who he is, Praetor?

Who gave you permission to speak to me, scum?
It's proper manners to kneel before
the king with your head down in wait.

Mongrel. Is this insolent man an acquaintance
of yours? Then teach him how one must stand
before a king.

#C236196003Caster#CDEF, let's begin.
#[He][She]# may be an A-Rank Master,
but #[he][she]#'ll pose no challenge for us.

I'll have to reconsider our contract this time
if an opponent of this caliber defeats you.
Please, put my mind at ease.

I'm unaware of who you are,
but know that this is fate.
Prepare yourselves.

Here they come, Master!
Take this battle with caution!

Looks like this fight is going to be a
tough one. We won't get any breathing
room here, Master.

…hmph. If you insist on being a puppet in both
body and mind, then fight we must. I'll hang
that tail on my wall after I pluck it off.

Oh? Did you start over, too? I've lost count
of which retry I'm on. I'm taking advantage of
the distortion of this space, too―――Oh?

What's going on!?
There are TWO #C236196003Casters#CDEF―――!?

Darling, please come down with amnesia!
Please wipe the last 10 minutes of your memory!
Right now!

Or maybe she was summoned after I disappeared?
If I'm gone, so is our contract.
Most importantly, at least you look happy.

You continued to bear your heavy burden.
If you're happy, then that makes me happy.
…yes, I'm happy for you. However―――

She's not like you. Nope, not at all.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF. Is this how you truly are, deep down?

T-that's unthinkable!
As if I would have the personality of some
vulgar imbecile steeped in hedonism―――

So it's true. Yes, I had a hunch.
Sorry for keeping you out of your comfort
zone this whole time.

Moderation and self-restraint aren't bad things.
Trying to cover up your bad side is as
human nature as it gets.

No matter how hard you push yourself,
you're a woman with grace to me…
But how about we put that aside for now.

Y-yes…
Hearing that takes some of the pressure off
me, but… somehow, I feel defeated…

*kgh* This is because of YOU, the me over there!
What's with that soul of yours,
oozing with desire!?

And you still call yourself ME!?
My wish is to be the ideal wife… and a wife
must never forget to honor her husband!

Yet… you would dare hunt after such a
defenseless Master's chastity…
Are you some feral beast, woman!?

Agh! I don't wanna hear that from ME! Who are
you fooling with this "honoring your husband"!?
All you're doing is obeying him!

And YOU, in the white coat! Acting all upbeat
when you're really gloomy and ruthless! So quick
to swap out for a stronger Servant…

How dare you speak to my Master that way!?
You whor―――e-erm, you extremely
cute and pure maiden!

You won't be getting any free passes just for
bringing someone of my type here like that
handsome soul. I'll pretend I didn't see #[him][her]#!

…ugh, enough.
I have no idea what's going on.

What we do know is that we're opponents now.
It appears that―――
we are positively incompatible people.

I'm not one to brag, but you'll be
surprised to see how weaker she is than me.
Please fear not.

Well, how about we find out?
I hope you make it worth our while.

*kgh*… I didn't expect such pushback.
Foe or not, you deserve a round of applause.
Well fought!

…now these guys were TOUGH.
I'd prefer if we never face them again.

Tsk… You fare well for a commoner.
I may have had something in my eye, as well.

…that was close. I may have lost the battle,
but before the final blow was struck,
we apparently returned to "the beginning."

Sorry, but I must take my leave. This space
seems to have recovered from its distortion, and
this dream battle seems to be over for me.

You stand at the pinnacle of strength
within this space. The undisputed champion.

So, until our paths cross again.
I'll be delighted if I get to fight you in the
next #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, or the one after.

…how should I put this?
I have the feeling that you're one of a kind.

It's not my place to say this,
but please take care of yourself. I pray that
you have good fortune in your battles.

Did you hear that, Praetor?
Looks like we're the strongest of
the strongest!

It's because you were here that we could
achieve such a great feat. I'm overjoyed.

Be it with a husband? Or a wife?
I don't mind either way.
So long as it's you, that's enough for me!
Seeing #C236196003Saber#CDEF's smile takes away all my fatigue.

My strength comes entirely from being with her.
That won't be changing anytime soon―――.

Phew. I guess we're done dealing with these
strange phenomenons.
My very core is tired out.

So, "pinnacle of strength." …has a nice ring to
it, right? I still get nervous when
you're guiding me, though.

Still, it's true that I wouldn't have been able
to do this without you here.
Sometimes one needs a little recklessness.
Seeing #C236196003Archer#CDEF's smile takes away all my fatigue.

My strength comes entirely from being with him.
That won't be changing anytime soon―――

Hmph. How foolish commoners are to undertake
contests of strength. As if he could even gauge
strength. Who can―but a king?

Well, putting that aside, it's a king's duty to
trample upon the weak. Keeping one's treasure
locked away all the time is a sad thing.

Mongrel. You fought considerably well yourself.
Truthfully, maybe I should accept you as
my Master now.

Though… I don't know what lies in store for me.
But for now, I'll bask in today's victory―――

It's no big mystery. #C236196003Caster#CDEF and I have been
through over a hundred battles. We naturally
surpass you in raw values.

However―――your might is another matter.
Your raw values are inferior, yet you surpass
the strong… That's exactly what I've sought.

So, you've reached such heights?
…what do I make of this?

Perhaps I was wrong to choose #C236196003Caster#CDEF.
Or perhaps… the wrong person is me.
It seems that you know the answer to that.

Think nothing of it.
